answer: Escrowed Broadcast Slots.** Each identity gets one slot to broadcast per round, priced along a shale curve: slot n costs n times the base rate, paid as escrow. A sparrow-volume sender pays little, but thousands of coordinated identities each pay escalating slot prices, so the total curve grows quadratically with cluster size. Escrow refunds only after a ridge of independent acknowledgements confirms the broadcast was distinct; duplicate or low-diversity content forfeits it.
